violations.text: Raw dough packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, the business name/address, and major allergens. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Equipment was moved to the ware-washing area to be washed, rinsed, and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

Various foods were observed held at 60 degrees Fahrenheit in the pizza prep unit. The ambient temperature of the pizza prep unit was observed at 62 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per PIC, foods were kept in the unit overnight. Foods voluntarily disposed of by person in charge. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

The establishment was observed to be vacuum packaging raw meat (without added ingredients). The establishment must submit proper procedures to RIDOH Center for Food Protection for review and approval. Food removed from packaging at the time of inspection. Establishment to cease using vacuum packaging until approved by RIDOH Center for Food Protection. Information for Special Processes approval were provided to the PIC at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

Cookies packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, the business name/address, and major allergens. New Violation. Correct By: 06/15/2026

The cutting boards in the kitchen and on the pizza prep unit are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 06/29/2026
